mostWorthwhile.text: The ending’s image of a world that can remember, renew and question gives the creation myth a satisfying sense of independence.

leastWorthwhile.text: The final chapter has no gameplay decisions, so there was no opportunity to shape that ending.

surprise.text: The history’s explicit admission that the origin of life remains unexplained stood out: it makes room for myth without presenting it as settled science.

arbitrary.text: Some symbolic combinations in the history, such as possibility and chorus making new makers, are evocative but not mechanically self-explanatory. I did not make those choices myself.

continue.text: I would be curious to see how the world’s inhabitants use their independence, though the ending feels complete and I had no active gameplay here to judge the decision-making firsthand.
